correctness.rationale: Rooted nonplane full binary unit-edge tree shapes admit unique size/order canonical enumeration. For a rooted join T=(U,V), the exact selected-subset PD generating polynomial is F_T=(1+t(F_U-1))(1+t(F_V-1)), with F_leaf=1+z. Independent direct root-to-leaf edge-set union enumeration agrees coefficientwise with this recursion for all 192 shapes through n=10, covering 131726 sampled subsets. The 2-tip histogram separates all n=4..9 shapes; for 98 ten-tip shapes the collision counts for k=1..9 are [94,1,13,39,102,232,576,1654,4753], each positive. Intersecting all 36 pairs of depth-collision sets leaves exactly (1,3),(1,4),(1,5),(2,3),(2,4),(2,5),(2,6),(2,7),(2,8) as complete identifying designs. This is a fully exhausted finite statement, not extrapolated to >10 leaves.

originality.rationale: Pachter and Speyer reconstruct trees from labeled subset-to-weight functions, substantially richer than an unlabeled histogram of fixed-size tip subsets; removing labels destroys implication. Faller-Pardi-Steel give forward phylogenetic-diversity distribution algorithms for a known tree, not inverse injectivity by sampling depth. Nipperess-Matsen provide only mean/variance. Resultary search produced other tree census/invariant findings, none the fixed-cardinality PD histogram 10-tip collision classification.
